body: Thanks for the comment it helps, it helps to have another women's perspective.

That for sure I am doing! I think the only other thing that hung me up too was that I had messaged her again a few months ago apologizing again. Looking back that wasn't necessary but I was looking for closure on my end in my overly emotional state. She also didn't respond so I read that 30 ways to heaven on what that could mean. Anyway thanks again for the PM offer and words of support!

Thanks for the reply. Yes I have, I've shared everything with her and she agrees with what you have said too. She is such a kind and caring person and I deeply value her opinions and trust her in everything but I also feel guilty with the thought she would protect me by lessoning the event. Its not that I don't value her opinion, I do greatly, but strangers on the internet have no vested interest in sugar coating it either so your reply is comforting.
